I = importlib
random.seed()
lock_info = Hash()
lp_points = Hash(default_value=0)

 
@export
def lock_lp_points(contract: str, amount: float, lock_time: float): #calculate lock_time seconds from frontend side 
    user = ctx.caller
    lock_time = datetime.timedelta(seconds=lock_time) 
    today = now
    pairs = ForeignHash(foreign_contract='con_amm_v9', foreign_name='pairs')
    #check if pair market exist
    assert pairs[contract], '{}-currency(TAU) pair does not exist!'.format(contract)
    
    assert amount > 0, 'negative value not allowed!'
    #check if date is beyond now
    assert  today + time_delta > now, 'invalid time!'
    
    rswp = I.import_module('con_amm_v9')
    rswp.transfer_liquidity_from(contract=contract, to=ctx.this, main_account=user, amount=amount)
    lp_points[contract, user] += amount
    #get id from hash
    hash_list = "".join([contract, user, str(amount), str(lock_time), str(now())])
    id = hashlib.sha256(hash_list)
    #get unlock date
    unlock_date = today + lock_time
    
    lock_info[contract, user] = {"lock_date":today, "initital_amount": amount, "amount": amount, "unlock_date": unlock_date, "lock_ID":id}
    return lock_info
 
@export
def withdraw_all(contract: str):
    user = ctx.caller
    lock_info = lock_info[contract, user]
    amount = lp_points[contract, user]
    assert amount > 0, 'no liquidity to unlock.'
    assert now >= lock_info["unlock_date"] , 'cannot unlock before unlock date.'
    rswp = I.import_module('con_amm_v9')
    rswp.transfer_liquidity(contract=contract, to=user, amount=amount)
    lp_points[contract, user] -= amount
    lock_info["amount"] -= amount
    lock_info["unlock_date"] = "withdrawn"
    return True
